component.name: VoiceGG
component.summary: The SteelSeries Sonar & SteelSeries GG alternative for Linux

description.p: VoiceGG is a lightweight, zero-latency gaming audio router, 10-band parametric equalizer, and ChatMix controller engineered natively for Linux and PipeWire.

ul.li: Virtual dedicated channels for Master, Game, Chat, Media, Aux, and Microphone.
Hardware-grade ChatMix slider to balance game sound against voice communications.
10-band parametric equalizer with calibrated competitive presets for CS2, Apex Legends, Valorant, and more.
Studio-grade microphone processing with zero-latency live voice monitoring (sidetone), RNNoise AI noise remover, gate, and dynamic compressor.
Minimal resource footprint (~6 MB RAM, 0.0% idle CPU) and 100% offline local privacy with zero telemetry.
Full Arabic (RTL) localization with Thmanyah typography.

description.p: VoiceGG 2.0 release introducing live microphone monitoring, native PipeWire filter chains, authentic Thmanyah design system, and full Arabic RTL localization.
